title: An Aquarius Quits When It Gets Cool
topic: Aquarius zodiac satire: an Aquarius quits when it gets cool
mechanism: Inside an Aquarius there is a lab with a telescope pointed away from people, a box of FEELINGS locked with a key labelled LATER, and one big switch marked IF POPULAR, STOP that drops anything the moment it gets popular.

beats.hook: A red street protest under an AQUARIUS placard: Iris, mid-chant, finally answers your text three days late
beats.story: Iris brews kombucha in her bathtub, wears wool socks with sandals on purpose, loves humanity but not humans, and her weird band plays to five people in a laundromat
beats.rise: Nobody understands her, and Iris is thrilled
beats.twist: Influencer Brooke walks into the laundromat and starts filming; by morning the video has a million views and the whole city dresses like Iris
beats.mechanism: A lab in her head: a telescope pointed away from people, a FEELINGS box locked with a key labelled LATER, and a big switch IF POPULAR, STOP that flips
beats.ending: She throws away her sandals, quits the band, the bathtub kombucha explodes, and by Friday she keeps bees and sings medieval choir music; her five fans and the influencer follow, and she replies from a beehive

seed.what: Brooke the influencer, filming herself with a ring light at the edge of the protest and later outside the laundromat window
